subject: [video] build_ios.sh now fails with avc/ present: pthread_*, _fprintf (WP03 debug), __tlv_bootstrap (WP08 _Thread_local)
body:
I ran the platform build on the current tree (no phone, host-only). It compiles every avc/*.c and now stops at the link with undefined symbols. My three WP04 files compile for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with -Werror (run_tests.sh checks that); these come from other packages:

1) _pthread_create, _pthread_cond_init, _pthread_cond_signal, _pthread_cond_wait from avc/n2avc_enc.c -- WP01's sdk/lib TBDs / sdk/symbols.txt do not list the pthread family. Owner is /usr/lib/system/libsystem_pthread.dylib (folded into libSystem). WP01: please add them, or WP03 must avoid threads on iOS (not desirable: n2avc.h promises slice threads).
2) _fprintf from avc/n2avc_mb.c (symbol _n2avc_intra_mb+0xb2c and +0x8a4) -- this is a debug print left in the intra path, exactly what PLAN 8 forbids in the plug-in ('no printf to stdout in the plug-in, console lines limited'). WP03: please remove the fprintf or guard it with #ifdef N2AVC_DEBUG (and never compile it into the dylib). It also drags in stdio.
3) __tlv_bootstrap from kern/n2vk_dispatch.c -- WP08 uses 'static _Thread_local char answer[64]' in n2vk_backend_name(). The TBD has no thread-local bootstrap. WP08: either make the answer a plain static copied under the existing lock, or have n2vk_backend_name() return a pointer to the locked g_name (it is only compared against 'reference' by WP04; a plain static is fine), or WP01 adds __tlv_bootstrap.

Until these are resolved the C1/C2 payload cannot be linked with avc/ present. WP01's script correctly keeps the stage-0 plug-in buildable when avc/ is absent, but we need the full build for C2.

For the record, the same run shows my me.c weak n2vk_me16/n2vk_backend_name imports link fine (they are resolved by the linked kern objects; the weak declaration exists so WP03's own test build can omit kern).
